institution.name: Vaughn College of Aeronautics and Technology

plan.notes: Source: official Vaughn College curriculum sheet 'AERONAUTICAL SCIENCE - Bachelor of Science (BS) (Effective: Fall 2017/Spring 2018)', Rev.03/2017 (vaughn.edu), transcribed exactly: eight semesters (17/15/15/15/16/15/15/16) = 124 credits (GRAND TOTAL CREDITS: 124). Credits used are the sheet's 'Total Cr.' per course. The three FAA written exams and CD101 Career Development are required 0-credit items (marked required_zero); the FAA exams are chain prerequisites (Private -> Instrument -> Commercial) and are prerequisites of FLT470/FLT471. Prerequisite honesty: developmental prerequisites (ENG109, MAT109/Placement) name real Vaughn courses but are not part of this sequence, so they are omitted rather than recorded against courses in the plan. MAT356's catalog prerequisite 'MAT220 OR MAT225' names courses not in this sequence; omitted honestly. Corequisites naming lab courses not listed separately (e.g. PHY120L, PHY220L, ATC220) are not modeled; their credit is included in the lecture course's total as published. All 'OR' elective slots (FLT345/441/447, FLT383/442, FLT384/443, Technical Elective/FLT444, Technical Elective/INT401, ENG220/ENG210 literature options, HIS141 competency option) are choice courses with catalog literals. Category mapping: general-education competency courses (ENG, MAT, PHY, ECO255, POL254, HIS141, FYI101) and competency-pick electives = core/elective; flight courses, FAA exams and technical electives = major/elective. No courses invented.
